_readme: Produce /app/results.json conforming to this schema. All analytical fields required.
active_nodes: int: count of operational nodes eligible for analysis
valid_links: int: count of usable links after data cleaning
data_issues_found: int: total node and link records excluded
community_count: int: number of structural communities detected
modularity: float: Newman-Girvan modularity Q of the community partition
community_map: object: keys are node ids as strings, values are integer community labels — include every active node

max_flow.value: COMPUTE: maximum flow between source and target using link capacities

critical_link.flow_impact: COMPUTE: decrease in max-flow when this single link is removed (the link causing the greatest decrease)

bridges: list of [int, int] pairs: links whose individual removal disconnects the network
